findings.evidence: The file provides `IsUnital.merge_zero`/`zero_merge` (lines 100-104) and `IsCollinearExact.merge_smul_one_sub_smul` (line 150) but nothing analogous for the other three predicates; `isCollinearExactOn_univ` (line 145) is the only relation between the set and global forms, so a consumer narrowing to a subset or starting from `IsCollinearExact` has to re-derive through `isCollinearExactOn_def`.
findings.fix: Add `IsCollinearExactOn.mono (h : S ⊆ T) : R.IsCollinearExactOn T → R.IsCollinearExactOn S`, `IsCollinearExact.isCollinearExactOn (S : Set V)`, `IsCollinearExactOn.merge_smul_one_sub_smul_of_mem`, and the matching `IsAdditive.merge_add` / `IsHomogeneous.merge_smul`.
findings.issue: `IsCollinearExactOn` — the form the PR says the p/E₀ schemes will have to meet on the massless momenta — has no monotonicity in `S`, no derivation from `IsCollinearExact`, and no elimination lemma; `IsAdditive` (line 82) and `IsHomogeneous` (line 114) likewise have no eliminators, while `IsUnital` and `IsCollinearExact` do.

summary: The scheme structure is extensional and the `_def`/`*_merge` restatements are in place, but `eScheme`'s body is exposed without need, its property lemmas are stated at a stronger typeclass than the definition, and `IsCollinearExactOn` (the predicate the deferred p/E₀ schemes are meant to consume) lacks monotonicity, a route from the global predicate, and an eliminator.
